# Test fixtures

- `[小栗 虫太郎] 黒死館殺人事件 (2012).kfx` — free Kindle edition of the
  public-domain text. Primary KFX fixture.
- `[太宰 治] 人間失格.kfx-zip` — Kindle download bundle, as delivered.
- `[太宰 治] 人間失格.kfx` — the container inside that bundle; paired with
  it in the kfx-zip merge tests.
- `[太宰 治] 人間失格.{epub,mobi,azw3}` — converted from the `.kfx` with
  calibre (KFX Input plugin).
- `fonts_only.kfx.gz` — KFX container stripped down to its bcRawFont and
  font entities, gzipped.
